acceptanceScenarios.given: A first-time player starts a new run from the main menu.
acceptanceScenarios.when: The tutorial stage asks the player to produce resources, place a basic guardian, and survive the first wave.
acceptanceScenarios.then: The player can complete all prompted actions without external instructions, the wave resolves, and the game advances to the next available stage.

acceptanceScenarios.given: A lane has at least one resource producer and the player has enough space to deploy a defender.
acceptanceScenarios.when: The player waits for resources, spends them on a defender, and survives a normal wave.
acceptanceScenarios.then: Resource count, cooldown state, unit placement, wave progress, and result state all update visibly and consistently.

acceptanceScenarios.given: The player has less resource than the selected defender requires.
acceptanceScenarios.when: The player attempts to deploy that defender.
acceptanceScenarios.then: The deployment is rejected, no resource is consumed, the board state is unchanged, and an explicit UI/audio feedback event is emitted.

acceptanceScenarios.given: An enemy type with a documented weakness enters a lane and the player has the corresponding guardian unlocked.
acceptanceScenarios.when: The player places the counter guardian in time.
acceptanceScenarios.then: The counter interaction triggers, enemy pressure is reduced, and combat logs or telemetry identify the counter rule used.

acceptanceScenarios.given: A lane has insufficient defense against an incoming wave.
acceptanceScenarios.when: The player takes no corrective action.
acceptanceScenarios.then: The enemy breaches the lane, the failure state is reached, and retry/exit actions are available without restarting the application.

acceptanceScenarios.given: The player has completed early waves in a stage.
acceptanceScenarios.when: Later waves spawn normal, elite, and final-pressure enemies according to the authored schedule.
acceptanceScenarios.then: Enemy composition, timing, warning UI, and win/fail conditions follow the frozen stage definition.

acceptanceScenarios.given: The player wins an authored stage.
acceptanceScenarios.when: The game saves progress, returns to stage select, exits, and reloads.
acceptanceScenarios.then: Unlocked stages, completed status, selected settings, and available units are restored exactly.

acceptanceScenarios.given: A stage is running with active enemies, cooldowns, animations, and audio.
acceptanceScenarios.when: The player pauses, changes a setting, resumes, and continues playing.
acceptanceScenarios.then: Simulation time is suspended during pause, settings take effect, and the resumed stage remains playable.

acceptanceScenarios.given: The frozen asset manifest contains all planned guardians, enemies, UI, effects, audio, and scene assets.
acceptanceScenarios.when: The integration validator loads every authored scene and prefab/reference graph.
acceptanceScenarios.then: Every planned asset is referenced at least once, every reference resolves, and there are no placeholder success fallbacks.

acceptanceScenarios.given: The highest authored stage is configured with maximum planned simultaneous lanes, units, enemies, effects, and UI overlays.
acceptanceScenarios.when: The smoke test runs the stage through the final pressure window.
acceptanceScenarios.then: The executable remains responsive, produces no blocking errors, and records performance within the frozen R1 execution budget.

acceptanceScenarios.given: Step07 signed style anchors for the micro-ecodome theme exist.
acceptanceScenarios.when: Representative gameplay screenshots, core character sprites, HUD, and result screens are reviewed against those anchors.
acceptanceScenarios.then: A human reviewer records pass/fail evidence for readability, originality, and style consistency.

acceptanceScenarios.given: A fresh installed R1 build is started with no previous save.
acceptanceScenarios.when: The automated regression path plays from tutorial through final authored stage, including one intentional failure and retry.
acceptanceScenarios.then: The run reaches the final win state, produces the expected evidence bundle, and leaves no unresolved correction queue entries.
